The figure illustrates the ContamCal pipeline as a three-stage process flowing from left to right, designed for a single-column width (~3.5 inches) in an academic paper style. The background is pure white, and all text labels use a clean, legible serif font (e.g., Times New Roman) at 8-9pt. The overall aesthetic is clean, professional, and optimized for publication quality at 300 DPI.
